name: Large-Tank Water Blaster — Shark
description: An electric water blaster with a 1,000 ml tank, about 62 × 6 × 20.4 cm. Comes with a battery, a charging cable and a screwdriver. Water only. Don't aim at faces or animals. Adult supervision for young children.

source.notes: Style code 917 (non-light, no pulse headline; ¥56). Match made from the style-list thumbnails. Photo text: capacity about 1000 ml, size 62x6x20.4 cm, gift battery + charging cable + screwdriver. Colours 蓝白色 (blue-white) and 黛蓝 (navy). A thin water-jet line at the muzzle was left in the first photo. Same 1688 offer (1089431913643) as the rest of the water-blaster range. MOQ unclear: the page says "1 Box starting batch" and lists carton counts of 12-48 pcs, so whether the price is per piece for a 1-piece order or needs a carton is unconfirmed. Prices are per piece from the style list. Store return rate not shown in the screenshots. China freight ¥4/order (note only, not costed). Lithium battery: sea freight only. Realistic firearm-shaped toy: possible customs hold as an imitation firearm, owner to confirm with the clearing agent. Range is stated only on the 2309 box photo (8-10 m, seller figure) and used there; none is claimed for other models. No safety certification shown or claimed. Supplier photos are 800 px (soft once enlarged).
